summary: Magicians 讨论 AA 与后量子、混合签名共存时的新型语义失效：同一签名在 ERC-1271、ERC-7913 与 AA 验证面之间可能被重放或误读，提议显式消息通道。VitalikButerin 列出 2026 年夺回自主权与无需信任的具体含义，包括借助 ZK-EVM 与 BAL 让本地运行全节点重新变得容易。potuz_eth 指出 blob gas 市场让时间博弈变得理性。

items.topic: 交易签名：跨验证面重放
items.title: Magicians：后量子与混合签名的显式消息通道，避免域分离“虫洞”
items.note: （pipavlo82）11:18：AA 与后量子、混合签名共存后，同一签名在密码学上有效，却可能在 ERC-1271、ERC-7913 与 AA 验证之间被重放或重新解释，这是语义而非密码学层面的失效。
items.title_en: Magicians: Explicit Message Lanes for PQ and Hybrid Signatures, avoiding domain separation wormholes
items.note_en: (pipavlo82), 11:18: as AA and post-quantum or hybrid signatures coexist, one cryptographically valid signature can be replayed or reinterpreted across ERC-1271, ERC-7913 and AA verification, a semantic rather than cryptographic failure.

items.title: potuz_eth：问题不在于玩时间博弈的实体，而在于 blob gas 市场让这样做变得理性，Glamsterdam 至少会把 blob 传播移出见证的关键路径
items.note: 20:55；EIP-7778：新增 gas_spent 收据字段（nerolation）提交。
items.title_en: potuz_eth: the problem is not entities playing timing games but a blob gas market that makes it rational, and Glamsterdam should at least move blob propagation out of the attestation hot path
items.note_en: 20:55; EIP-7778: add a gas_spent receipt field (nerolation), submitted.

keywords_en: Explicit message lanes for post-quantum and hybrid signatures
Vitalik on taking back self sovereignty and trustlessness in 2026
a blob gas market that rewards timing games
EIP-7778 adds a gas_spent receipt field
summary_en: A Magicians post described a new semantic failure as AA and post-quantum or hybrid signatures coexist: one signature can be replayed or reinterpreted across ERC-1271, ERC-7913 and AA verification surfaces, so it proposes explicit message lanes. VitalikButerin listed what taking back self sovereignty and trustlessness means in 2026, including easier local full nodes thanks to ZK-EVM and BAL. potuz_eth said the blob gas market makes timing games rational.
